conversation.message: Mostly I’ve been really having trouble getting things finished and keeping track of stuff. I lose my belongings a lot and miss deadlines at work, which has been a problem—I’m on a performance plan now. It’s been making me pretty frustrated and honestly hurting my self-esteem too.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m not sure if you mean anything beyond that attention diagnosis, or like something else from before. I don’t think there’s much more to add right now.

Yes—nicotine includes cigarettes, vaping, and other nicotine products. Based on what you said, I’ve recorded that you do not use them.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I want to keep my job and feel competent at it. And, I guess, stop feeling like I’m falling behind all the time.
